title: Three ways to mistake progress for proof

hotspots.label: Myth: the documents are uploaded, so the lab is done.
hotspots.detail: An accepted upload is not yet a searchable document, and a searchable document is not yet a proven one.

hotspots.label: Myth: the counts match, so permissions are right.
hotspots.detail: Counting indexed documents proves nothing about permissions. Search as each persona.

hotspots.label: Myth: the scheduled job is green.
hotspots.detail: A completed Job proves only that the process exited successfully. Document status proves indexing.
